dedupe_keys.name: icssim framework for industrial control system security simulation testbeds

description: Open-source code for building virtual industrial control system testbeds for cyber attack research. The arXiv abstract of paper 2210.13325 (Computers in Industry 148, 2023) says ICSSIM provides base classes to simulate control system components and communications, runs components in Docker containers for realistic network emulation, and supports physical process modelling with software and hardware in the loop; it was demonstrated with a bottle filling factory testbed and several cyber attacks. The code is free to download from GitHub under the MIT licence. Coverage is generic industrial processes the user models. Caveats: the sample process is small and the page read does not give fidelity measures. For simulation it lets users stage attacks on plant control networks and see the effect on the physical process, to study cyber-physical disruption of manufacturing. A related catalogue record is ICS-SimLab.
